purpose: Provide the fail-closed exact composition rule requested by GRF-01 step D: keep local systems separate by default, but combine exact residue-local admissible sets across pairwise-coprime moduli when CRT materially simplifies the symbolic system.

mathematical_kernel.domain: pairwise-coprime moduli q_1,...,q_t >=2; one common integer parameter vector z in Z^n; exact residue-local admissible sets S_i subset (Z/q_i Z)^n
mathematical_kernel.crt_bijection: (Z/QZ)^n is canonically bijective to product_i (Z/q_iZ)^n by componentwise reduction.
mathematical_kernel.admissible_product: The global residue set S_Q consisting of classes whose reduction lies in every S_i is canonically bijective to product_i S_i.
mathematical_kernel.emptiness_rule: S_Q is empty iff at least one S_i is empty. A certified empty 2-adic or odd-prime local image is therefore a global necessary-condition obstruction for the same source-locked system.
mathematical_kernel.cardinality_rule: |S_Q|=product_i |S_i| for exact residue-local sets under the stated common-variable adapter.
mathematical_kernel.scope: This is exact CRT set composition, not probabilistic independence and not permission to multiply pruning credits.
mathematical_kernel.noncoprime_case: If moduli are not pairwise coprime, this kernel does not apply; use one exact common-modulus system instead.
mathematical_kernel.semantic_identity: Every S_i must refer to the same integer variables and the same family semantics, with exact reduction maps. Similar-looking local filters on different parameterizations cannot be combined without an adapter.

composition_with_grf.allowed: combine only when the exact variable/family adapter and pairwise-coprime moduli are source-locked
composition_with_grf.sat_semantics: all local systems SAT means only that the combined local necessary-condition system is SAT; it proves neither integrality nor geometric existence

ownership.concrete_application_owner: specialist lane supplying the exact current target adapter; MAIN retains only the CRT theorem schema

next_route.main: Freeze the GRF-01 A-D symbolic suite as one audit-ready no-credit checkpoint.
next_route.specialists: Apply local kernels to concrete current populations only with exact subset and overlap/accounting certificates.
